name: Wagholi
civicNote: One of 23 villages notified into PMC (draft Dec 2020, final 2021).
summary: A former village on Pune's north-eastern edge, east of Kharadi along the Pune-Ahmednagar road. It became part of PMC in 2021.
knownFor: Wagheshwar temple, after which the town is named
Historical link to Maratha commander Pilajirao Jadhavrao
connectivity: Road link to Lohegaon and the airport side
suits: Buyers working in Kharadi and east Pune who want newer housing on the city's north-eastern edge.
